name: Default
shortDescription: Drag-and-drop dashboard for an existing Home Assistant instance, with live state over WebSocket and layouts saved as YAML.

alerts.message: Set HASS_URL to the HTTPS address of an existing Home Assistant instance before deploying. Browsers block a plain HTTP Home Assistant URL from this HTTPS dashboard.

HA-Fusion has no login of its own: anyone who can open the URL can edit the dashboard, and a long-lived access token saved in its settings is served to every visitor. Sign in through Home Assistant instead of saving a token, or restrict access to the domain.
